newsitem.title: THAILAND: Ch Karnchang unit in expressway deal.
newsitem.headline: Ch Karnchang unit in expressway deal.

text.p: Thai construction firm Ch Karnchang Plc said on Monday its joint venture unit JV BBCT had signed an agreement with North Bangkok Expressway Co Ltd to build an expressway.
The cost of the expressway will eventually reach about 14.15 billion baht (US$566 million), Ch Karnchang said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

JV BBCT is a joint venture between Ch Karnchang with 59.98 percent stake, Bilfinger und Berger Bauaktiengesellshaft with 40 percent, Ch Karnchang-Tokyo Construction Co Ltd with 0.01 percent and Tokyo Construction Co Ltd with 0.01 percent, Ch Karnchang said.

Northern Expressway, a wholly-owned unit of Bangkok Expressway Plc, won a concession from the government to build and operate the 34-km (21-mile) expressway from Bangkok's northern fringes to the town of Bang Pa-in.
